fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a black smartphone belonging to the complainant was taken near Vaigai Layout Market Road. The matter was brought to Tiruppur North PS on 2025-12-02, while the incident was placed on 2025-12-02 at roughly 09:20. Vasanth Mani (9000000382), described as a friend of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. Harish Babu (9000000422) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Logesh Subramani (mobile 9000000233) was named as a possible person of interest. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly approached from behind and took the phone before leaving the spot.
